tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bla med lhan skyes rnam bzhi'i rdzogs rim snying po don gyi phreng ba u pa de sha gaṃ bhī ra

zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo badz+ra gu ru ā di de wa tā ya/ 'dir dbang thob cing dam sdom la gnas pa'i slob ma la/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob dpon gyis lhan skyes rnam pa bzhi'i rdzogs rim zab mo shin tu bsdus pa'i tshul gyis ston pa ni/ rdzogs rim bzhi ga'i sngon 'gro thun mong ba/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba la/ de mi rtag pa/ las 'bras/ rigs drug gi sdug bsngal rnams dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa/ skyabs 'gro// rdor sems| maṇ+ḍal/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams spyi 'gro ltar byas pas rgyud legs par sbyangs zin nas/ dngos gzhi dang po pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod pa'i rdzogs rim rdo rje'i phreng ba sogs bshad rgyud chen po brgyad kyi dgongs pa/ 'phags lugs mar mtshur yab sras kyi bzhed srol ltar rigs lnga gdan gcig 'khor lo med pa'i lugs shin tu bsdus pa ni/ dang po rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i bskyed rim ni khyad par gyi sngon 'gro yin te/ lus rnam snang chos bdun dang ldan pa'i mtshan bcas rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ rang nyid zhe sdang rdo rje dpa' bo gcig par gsal ba'i thugs kar 'od kyi dkyil 'khor me long tsam bsgrengs pa'i ldebs dbus su/ thig le dkar po a shad nag pos mtshan pa zhig bsam pa'i ngang nas rlung ro bsal te/ slar sna bug nas rlung rgyu ba hūm̐ gi rnam pa sna sgor thon pa'i tshe hūm̐ de dag sprul pa'i sku dpag tu med par gyur/ 'gro ba'i don byas/ mi bskyod rdo rje'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur rngub pa'i tshe phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs oṃ gyi rnam par rtse mgo nas mar sib sib song bar dmigs nas nang du gnas pa'i tshe/ āḥyig gi rnam par bsam la ci mang du dmigs so// mtshan med ni/ rang lhar gsal tsam nas rlung sngags dbyer med ma bcos gzhom par don dam brjod yul las 'das par rlung nang du rngub pa oṃ/ gnas pa āḥ

phyir dbyung ba hūm̐ rnams gdod nas ma grub pa yin pa la dran shes yun ring du bsgom/ de yang 'byung 'jug gnas gsum yi ge gsum du bcos nas bsgom pa min zhing*/ ngag nas brjod pa'ang min gyi/ de ltar don gyi bzlas pa rlung sems tha mi dad du 'khrul pa'i rjes su mi 'brang bar rtse gcig tu gnas pa ste ma yeng bar sgom dgos pa yin no// sngon 'gro rgyas pa dben gsum sogs gsungs pa yang 'dir 'du'o// de ltar yun ring du sbyangs pas rtsa ba'i rlung lnga 'dus pa'i rtags su/ du ba lta bu ser ljang dang*/ smig rgyu lta bu sngo ljang dang*/ me khyer lta bu dmar ljang dang*/ sgron me lta bu dkar ljang rnams g.yo bzhin pa dang*/ nam mkha' ltar gsal dwangs ngos bzung med pa 'byung*/ des ni phrag dog dag pa bya grub ye shes don yod grub par 'char ro// gnyis pa sems la mi dmigs pa'ang khyad par gyi sngon 'gro yin/ steng 'og gi rlung 'then la bzung nas/ rang lhar gsal ba la ma yeng bar sems gtad cing rlung bzung ba nas 'byung bzhi'i rlung zin pa ni rnam par shes pa snang ba la thim pa ni/ stong pa'i ye shes kyi skabs te sems zin pa'i rtags snang ba tse ring ring ba dang*/ lus 'jag ma ltar ldem ldem pa'o// rang lhar gsal ba la ma yeng bar sems snying ga'i 'od me long lta bu la thim par dmigs nas 'od dkyil la sems ma yeng par gtad/ rlung bzung nas snang ba mched pa la thim pas/ stong pa chen po'i ye shes zhe sdang las gyur pa'i rang bzhin sum cu rtsa gsum thim rtags zla 'od lta bu skya lam lam pa 'byung*/ yang rlung dang bcas 'od kyi me long thig le la bsdus/ thig le la sems ma yengs par bsgoms pas mched pa nyer thob la gnas nas shin tu stong pa'i ye shes 'dod chags las gyur pa'i rang bzhin bzhi bcu thim/ rtags nyi 'od lta bu dmar lam lam pa 'byung*/ rtags can nam mkha' ltar sngo sangs sang ba gnag ling ling ba 'ong*/

yang rlung bcas thig le a thung la bsdus nas a thung la sems ma yengs par bsgoms pas nyer thob 'od gsal la thim nas/ thams cad stong pa'i ye shes ma rig pa las gyur pa'i rang bzhin bdun thim/ rtags mun pa lta bu nag thum thum pa 'byung*/ rtags can rang lus 'od phung lta bu'i 'od 'phro ba 'byung*/ lar rtags 'di tsho khrigs chags kyi nges pa med pas go rim 'chol ba'ang 'byung srid do// des ni 'dod chags dag pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes sangs rgyas 'od dpag med du 'char ro// de dag ni khyad par gyi sngon 'gro yang yin no// dngos gzhi bden pa gnyis kyi tshul gyis nyams su blang ba la/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa med pa bzhin du snang ba sgyu ma lta bu'i tshul bsgom pa'i phyir sgyu lus kyi rim pa ni/ a thung snang la ngos bzung med pa gnag phrig phrig pa shin tu phra ba la sems gtad pa de yang snang la rang bzhin med pa sogs sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyis mtshon par bsgom/ yang sgyu ma gzung ba ni/ mdun du lha sku me long la shar ba la bstod smad byas pas/ dga' sdug sogs 'dug gam mi 'dug blta/ de mi 'dug pa dang lha sku de dmigs pas mdun du phyung nas de la bstod smad byas pas dga' sdug sogs 'dug gam mi 'dug blta/ mi 'dug na de nyid sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis sogs kyis brtags nas bsgom/ de sgyu ma de med bzhin du snang bar rtogs nas mdun du lha'i sku mi dmigs par rang la bstims nas rang lha sku sgyu ma lta bur bsgom/ rang lus lhar gsal ba la bstod smad dang*/ g.yas nas tsan dan gyi lde gus byugs pa la dga' zhing chags pa med pa dang*/ g.yon nas ste'us gzhog pa la mi 'jigs shing sdang ba med pa sgyu ma ltar sbyong bar bya'o// de yang dngos po thams cad la rang dbang med par khyab pa sgyu ma'i sprul pa lta bu/ gsal la ma 'dres pa 'ja' tshon lta bu/ rlung dang 'od zer las grub pa mig 'phrul lta bu/

gcig la gnyis sam med par snang ba mig yor lta bu/ gang gis kyang gzhig par mi nus pa grib ma lta bu/ gcig gis kun la khyab pa chu nang gi zla ba lta bu/ yan lag dang nying lag tu snang ba me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu/ gnas yul du snang ba dri za'i grong khyer lta bu/ nyams su myong yang ngo bo med pa rmi lam lta bu/ ro gcig la du mar 'char ba chu bur lta bu/ 'phro ba myur ba brag cha lta bu/ 'khyug pa myur ba glog lta bu ste/ sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyis mtshon nas tshogs drug thams cad sgyu mar sbyong ba shin tu gal che'o// slar lha sku bsdus nas a shad snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu la sems gtad nas rlung bzung*/ de'i tshe nam mkha' la 'gro ba sogs kyi nyams byung na sgyu ma 'byongs pa'i rnam thar skyes pa yin no// de nas sgyu ma sbyang ba ni/ nyams ci skyes kyang dga' zhing rlom pa med par ngam grog dang*/ g.yang sa dang*/ chu dang*/ ri brag /me phung sogs la thogs pa med par stong thal thal btang ba sogs sgyu ma'i rnam par spel bar bya'o// bdag gi lus 'di bar do'i dus su sgyu ma'i lus kyang sgyu lus su shes shing longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur ldang bar bya'o snyam du 'phen pa yang yang btang*/ de ltar nyin mo bsgom/ mtshan mo rmi lam sgyu ma ltar sbyong ba yang gong ltar lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i a thung la sems gtad/ rmi lam la rmi lam du shes par bya'o snyam du 'phen pa btang la gnyid log /rmi lam zin pa'i tshe/ rmi lam yin rmi lam sgyu ma yin pas cir yang bsgyur tu btub bsam pas spel zhing sbyang ba dang bsgyur ba la bslab/ bdag gi rmi lam 'di sgyu ma yin sgyu ma'i snang ba 'di longs skur ldang ba bya'o snyam du lha'i skur ldang ba sogs bya/ yang rmi lam bar do yin/ srid pa bar dor yang tshul 'di ltar nyams su blang bar bya'o snyam du 'phen pa yang yang btang*/

des ni zhe sdang dag pa me long lta bu'i ye shes sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa yang 'char ro// bzhi pa don dam bden pa snang yang ngo bo ma grub pa rang bzhin med pa 'od gsal gyi rim pa ni/ sgyu mar snang tsam pa'i gnyis snang gi rtog pa de yang 'od gsal stong pa phyag rgya chen po'i mes sbyong ba yin la/ 'di la'ang gzhi lam 'bras bu'i 'od gsal gsum/ gzhi'i 'od gsal la'ang gzhi'i spyi don gyi 'od gsal ni/ sems nyid rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba nyid yin/ gzhi'i sbas don gyi 'od gsal ni/ 'chi ba'i tshe nyer thob 'od gsal la thim ma thag /brjod med kyi 'od gsal bde ba chen por yud tsam re 'char ba de nyid yin no// de dag gi ngo bor 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs ni/ lam gyi 'od gsal nyams su blangs pa ste/ de'ang nyin par 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i tshe zhi ba dang drag po gnyis las/ zhi bar 'dzin pa ni/ rang lhar gsal ba ril 'dzin nam/ rjes gzhig gi bsam gtan gnyis po gang rung gis stong pa chen por bsdus la/ sems nam mkha' ltar mtha' dbus med pa/ nyi zla ltar 'od gsal ba/ rgya mtsho ltar dwangs ba/ ri bo ltar g.yo 'gul med par bzhag go// drag por 'dzin pa ni/ rang lhar wal gyis gsal bas rang ngam grogs kyi rtsa rba rlabs rim gyis bcings nas srog 'gag pa'i tshe/ 'byung ba bzhi dang snang mched gsum thim pa'i rtags man ngag ltar ngos bzung ba'i mthar srog 'gags pa dang lhan cig skad cig ma'i 'od gsal shi ba'i dus dang cha 'dra ba 'byung la yun ring du 'jog cing*/ tshul de ni 'chi ba'i tshe yang nyams su blang ba'i gnad man ngag dam pa'o// mtshan mo gnyid mthug gi 'od gsal 'dzin pa'ang bla ma spyi bor bsgoms/ mdun du yi dam bsgoms la 'od gsal zin par gsol ba btab/ dkon mchog dag gi rten la mchod pa 'bul/ yi dam dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong la mi shas brgyan pa'i gtor ma phul nas gong ltar gsol ba btab/

dkar me mtshan thub btang*/ sngas byang du bstan seng ge'i nyal stabs byas la bla ma spyi bor bstims/ gnyid mthug gi gti mug 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i 'phen pa btang*/ rang lhar gsal ba'i snying khar pad+ma sngon po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar mi shigs pa'i thig le sngon po 'od 'bar ba la shes pa gtad/ gnyid kyi thim rim ngos bzung*/ gnyid la 'gro ba'i tshe thig le la sems ma yeng bar gtad nas gnyid du btang*/ grogs kyis bltas pas dbugs bde ngo mdangs gsal na zin pa yin/ de las ldog na ma zin pa yin pas gnyid sad slar 'dzin pa yin/ de'i tshe gnyid log tu ma btub na stong 'byams yin pas zas bcud can bsten/ smin mtshams su thig le nag po bsgom/ des kyang ma byung ba gnyid log dus su rba rlabs gnyis cung zad mnan/ gnyid mthug drag pa ni rdug 'byams yin pas/ gos srab tu btang*/ rlung bum pa can bzung*/ zin la khad du gnyid sad na sad 'byams yin pas de'i gnyen po stong 'byams dang 'dra zhing gnyid kyi bgegs rnams spongs/ rmi lam kho nas khyer na dred 'byams yin pas/ gong gi thig le de nyid nag por bsgom/ rlung mi gzung*| de ltar byas pas gnyid srab mo zin nas gnyid du 'gro ba dang lhan cig nyi ma shar ba ltar dwangs shing gsal la blo'i 'dzin pa dang*/ tshogs drug gi der snang cung zad tsam yod pa la de'i 'khrul blo'i rjes su mi 'brang ba 'byung*/ gnyid mthug pos zin na/ gsal stong nam mkha' lta bu 'dzin med kyi ting nge 'dzin ches brtan pa 'byung*/ de ltar zin nas grogs dang mar me sogs mi dgos par/ rang nyid kho nas sbyang*/ de la 'bad pas rab tshe 'dir/ 'bring gis 'chi kha'i 'od gsal ngos zin na grol bar 'gyur ro// 'chi ba'i tshe gang la'ang ma chags pa'i ngos nas bla ma yab yum la 'chi ba lam du slong bar gsol ba btab nas thim rim ngos bzung tha ma'i tshe/ gong gi btsan thabs sam gnyid mthug gi skabs ltar 'dzin grogs kyis brda sbyar bas 'chi ba 'od gsal chos skur grol ba gdon mi za'o// zhib cha zhal la dris/

'di'i rtags sprin med pa'i nam mkha' rkyen gsum dang bral ba lta bu 'byung*/ des ni gti mug dag pa chos dbyings ye shes sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad du 'char ro// lnga pa zung 'jug gi rim pa ni/ de ltar lam gyi dngos gzhi sgyu lus dang 'od gsal gyis nyams su blang ba'ang tha dad ya bral ma yin pa/ snang phyogs sgyu ma lta bu/ stong phyogs 'od gsal stong nyid nam mkha' lta bu zung 'jug tu nyams su blang ba yin te/ nyin mtshan 'chi dus kyi 'od gsal gang yin yang*/ stong pa chen po khyab gdal gsal dwangs de'i ngang nas/ khams gsum thams cad rdo rje 'chang gi skur snang bas tshogs drug thams cad mi sgrib par gsal ba/ der 'dzin med pa stong pa dang snang ba phyogs gcig tu gang du yang brjod du med pa gnyis su med pa'i nyams 'char ba ni lam dus kyi zung 'jug yin la/ shi ba dang skad cig ma dang por 'od gsal chen po lam gyis zin pa'i tshe chos sku mnyam yang mtha' bral chen por ngang gis ma sgrub kyang 'grub la/ de las ma g.yos bzhin du tshogs drug gi snang cha sgyu ma lta bu dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig tu 'char ba rnams/ der 'dzin 'khrul blo med par snang stong chu zla lta bur 'char bas zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku skad cig la 'bad pa med par 'grub pa yin no// des ni nga rgyal dag pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan du 'char ro// mjug rnams su bsngo bas rgyas btab thun mtshams thams cad du tshogs drug snang la rang bzhin med pa/ sems dang sems byung tha dad med cing brjod med bzo bral 'od gsal chen po de'i ngang las rang mdangs bskyed rim lha sku sgyu ma lta bur nan gyi sbyang ngo*/ yan lag dang 'pho ba grong 'jug gtum mo sogs nag khrid du shes par bya'o zhes pa ni/ pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa'i rdzogs rim lam rim lnga pa 'khor lo med pa can mdor bsdus pa zab mor gdams pa'i skabs so/// /

༈ /yang ma rgyud 'khor lo sdom pa'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa grub chen dril bu zhabs kyi dgongs pa ltar nyams su blang ba ni/ sngon 'gro rnams gong ltar las/ dngos gzhi'i lam dril bu rim lngar grags pa la'ang*/ rim pa dang po dang gnyis pa/ khyad par gyi sngon 'gro// gsum pa dngos gzhi/ bzhi pa cha lag /lnga pa ngo sprod kyi tshul du ston te/ dang po yid dag par byed pa rang byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa la gsum gyi sa bon med pa chen po ni/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan pas rang gi sems yul la 'jug pa 'di nyid tshogs drug gi rnam rtog der 'dzin dang bcas pa bkag nas rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang du ci gnas su 'jog pa nyid do// sa bon dang bcas pa ni/ gal te de lta bur sems gnas par ma nus na rang 'khor lo sdom pa yab rkyang du gsal ba'i thugs kar āḥlas zla ba phyed pa sran ma phyed gshag tsam gyi steng mi shigs pa'i thig le yungs 'bru tsam dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can/ rang bzhin stong pa/ rnam pa gsal ba/ ngo bo zung du 'jug pa la sems gtad la mi spro bar bsgom/ de la sems zin kyang dbang shes sogs yul la 'pho na/ mig dbang gzugs la 'pho na/ mig tu thig le dkar po/ de bzhin rna ba sgrar 'pho na thig le nag po/ sna drir 'pho na ser po/ lce ror 'pho na dmar po/ lus reg byar 'pho na rdo rje'i rtser ljang gu rnams gang rung sgom pa la sems bzung*/ mthar tshogs drug gang la 'pho ba dang*/ de'i dbang shes dbyer med rtsol bral du bsgom/ sa bon med pa zhes bya ba ni/ rlung sems gnyis lhan cig tu 'ching ba ste/ rang gi lus kyi rlung zla nyi zung 'jug gi bdag nyid gsum du gnas pa lus kyi steng du g.yas g.yon mnyam pa gsum/ bar du steng 'og bar gsum/ smad du rtsa gsum gyi dbye bas gsum ste/ thams cad kyang rdo rje gsum du mos nas/ lus gnad snga ma lta bu la/ lag gnyis pus mo'i steng du sa gnon byas la/

sna bug gang nas rlung rgyu ba de 'jug gnas dbyung gsum ma bcos rang babs la sems bzung*/ rlung de'i kha dog dmar smug dmar skya la sems bzung*/ rlung de nyid nang du zhugs tshe lus thams cad khyab par bsgom/ de bzhin du rlung rgyu ba'i phyogs kyi sna bug la'ang sbyar/ mthar gnyis ka la'ang sbyar/ yang steng 'og gi rlung man ngag ltar bum pa kha sbyor dang*/ 'og rlung rgyab rlung gnyis la'ang de ltar sbyar nas bsgom/ mthar gong gi thig le dang rlung stabs cig tu sbyar nas bsgom/ des ni lha'i mig sogs thob par byed do// gnyis pa rlung dag par byed pa sna tshogs rdo rje'i rim pa la'ang sa bon dang bcas pa dang*/ sa bon med pa gnyis las/ sa bon dang bcas pa ni/ lus gnad gong ltar la rlung ro bsal/ steng rlung 'og rlung kha sbyor drag po bzung la/ lus nang 'od kyi rang bzhin can gyi rlung gis gang bar bsam/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lte ba mthing ga'i dbus su āḥlas chos 'byung gi nang du hūm̐ las rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar zla ba la hūm̐ dkar la dmar bas mtshan pa la sems gtad/ mthar hūm̐ gi thig le la sems ci gnas su bzhag /de las g.yon lus nang du dhū ti gsal ba rlung 'od dhū ti'i nang du mar song bas bde ba skyed par bsgom/ de bzhin du gsang gnas su yang sna tshogs rdo rje sogs snga ma lta bu bsgoms pa'i rlung 'od phreng 'phro ba la sems gtad/ yul la sems 'pho na gang du 'pho ba'i mig sogs dbang po so sor sna tshogs rdo rje bhaiṃ// de ltar 'bad pas nyi zla skar ma lta bu'i rtags snang 'char/ yang lus gnad gong ltar la sna bug g.yas nas rlung bus mdzod spu'i thad du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la sems gtad/ yang g.yon nas bus nyi dkyil de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du gyur par sems gtad/ yang gnyis ka nas bus pas zla dkyil dbus su thig le sngon po/

shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba'i thig le lngar gyur pa bsams te/ thig le rnams res mos su sems gtad/ de rnams kyi tshe rlung bus nas nang du mi rngub par phyir 'dzin la ci thub tu bzung mi thub pa'i tshe nang du brngub/ dmigs pa de nyid rim pa ltar gsal bar bsgom/ de nas mig la sogs pa'i dbang po'i sgo rnams su yang bsam/ sems dang yang bsre/ des ni snga ma'i bogs 'don zhing lha'i mig sogs rgyud nas gsungs pa rnams nges par 'thob pa'o// lnga pa nor bu 'gengs pa'i rim pa zhes lam gyi dngos gzhi phyag rgya bzhi bsgom pa la dam tshig /las/ chos/ phyag rgya chen po dang bzhi las/ dang po dam tshig gi phyag rgya ni/ lus rnam snang chos bdun dang ldan pas/ rang 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i pang du yum rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal btab pa'i yab yum gyi mkha' gsang sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlabs rjes/ rang gi lte bar/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ snying khar/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mgrin par/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba raṃ swā hā/ dpral bar/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yum gyi lte bar/ oṃ shrī badz+ra= snying khar/ oṃ hrī ha= mgrin par/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro= dpral bar/ oṃ sarba bud+dha= de ltar gsal btab nas 'du shes gsum ldan gyis snyoms par zhugs pas byang sems spyi bo nas mgrin par slebs par dga' ba/ snying khar mchog dga'/ lte bar dga' bral/ gsang bar lhan skyes rnams so sor mnyam par bzhag /nor bu'i rtse mor son pa dang ldog pa gsum gyi sbyor bas hūm̐ zhes yar ldog pas lte bar dga' ba/ snying khar mchog dga'/ mgrin par dga' bral/ spyi bor lhan skyes la mnyam par bzhag /dmigs pa rno bas kun+da 'pho bar nye na lag gnyis khu tshur bcings pa snying khar bsnol/ mig gnyis gyen du ldog

/lce ya rkan la sbyar/ hrīṃ zhes rlung oṃ gyen du 'then la byang sems dhū ti'i nang du 'phos pas spyi bo'i haṃ la thim par bsgom mo| |las kyi phyag rgya ni/ pad+ma can sogs bsten byar 'os pa la drang nges kyi chos bshad pas blo bcos/ dbang gis smin par byas nas tshul dang mthun pa'i gnas su/ rang dang rig ma 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum du bskyed pa'i mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs nas/ so sor sngags bkod nas/ brda dang sngags kyi sbyor bas 'du shes gsum ldan gyi snyoms 'jug bya/ byang sems phab cing dga' bzhi'i ye shes la mnyam par bzhag /'phor nye ba'i tshe/ rab ting 'dzin/ 'bring dmigs lung*/ tha mas 'khrul 'khor gyi sgo nas dbab 'dzin 'dren ldog gis dgram rtsa mig tu gdab pa bya zhing*/ 'khrul 'khor dgos byung na rung mthun gzhan nas kha bskang du rung ngo*/ zhib cha zhal du gab bo// chos kyi phyag rgya ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i yid rig dang*/ dngos rig gang yin yang snyoms 'jug gi bya ba byas zin ma thag /rig ma hūm̐ dmar skyar gyur pa rang gi rdo rje'i lam nas rgyu ba skad cig gis thur sel rlung glog gi zhags pa lta bus bkug cing drangs pa gsang lte snying mgrin dpral bar slebs pa dga' ba bzhi so sor ngos bzung mthar spyi bo'i haṃ la bstims dmigs med du bzhag /slar tshogs drug gi yul snang gang shar ba bde stong lhan skyes kyi myong ba dang bsre/ rang babs bcos min gyi nyams bzo med gcer yan du skyong*/ phyag rgya chen po ni/ sems gsal stong zung 'jug /lam bde stong lhan skyes kyi gdams pa/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i zung 'jug lhan skyes bsam du med pa'i ngo bor bzhag cing*/ de'i rtsal snang rnams kyang nyi ma dang 'od zer ltar gcig min tha dad min pa'i ngo bor bzo med du bsgoms pas rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa nyid 'char bas de la goms par bya'o// bzhi pa na lan+dha ra'i rim pa zhes grol lam pa'i dbang du mdzad pa lam gyi cha lag ni/

lus rnam snang chos bdun sngar ltar la lag pa g.yas g.yon bsnol nas dpung pa'i bar lta bu la 'jus te/ rang gi lte 'og sor bzhir chos 'byung phyi dkar nang dmar ba'i dbus su thig le sngon po/ mdun du dkar po/ g.yas su ser po/ rgyab tu dmar/ g.yon tu ljang gu rnams bhaiṃ/ rlung ro bsal nas srog thur gyi rlung bum pa kha sbyor byas pas/ thig le so so la gtum mo'i me rang rang gi mdog can shin tu phra zhing rno ba 'bar ba la sems rtse gcig tu gtad/ de la goms nas me rnams cher 'bar ba'i 'od 'dres pa sna bug g.yas nas phyir thon phyogs thams cad du 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i zhing 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad shangs bug g.yas su zhugs nas sku'i dbyibs brgyud de lte bar song nas gyen du 'bar bas de dag gi sku'i lte ba/ thugs ka /mgrin pa/ spyi bo rnams bsregs te/ byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar rnams spyan drangs shangs bug g.yon pa nas thon/ rang gi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs te dhū ti'i nang brgyud lte ba'i me lnga la 'dres pas bde drod gsal stong zung 'jug gi nyams tshad med pa skyes/ slar rang gi lte ba'i me lnga cher 'bar bas rgyal ba 'khor bcas kyi byang chub kyi sems dang tha mi dad pas rang gi spyi bo nas rkang mthil yan chad bar med du gang ba la sems gtad/ srog thur bum can du bzung nas 'di la goms pas/ lte ba sogs gnas gang du byang sems brtan pa der de dag gi yon tan rgyud nas ji snyed gsungs pa ltar 'byung bas nan tan du sgom pa gal che'o// lnga pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rim pa zhes/ ngo 'phrod nas nyams myong skyes pa yin te/ tshogs drug gi yul snang gang shar ba de nyid bcos min gyi sems mi shigs pa'i ming can dang ro mnyam par byas te/ de yang bsam tshogs drug gis sems ma 'brang*/ tshogs drug gi sems kyi yul du ma 'dres/

de de'i rjes su ma 'brangs par snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma'i dpe ltar nyams su myong ba nyid du yun bsgoms pas snang sems zung du 'jug par 'gyur te/ sna tshogs su snang ba ji snyed pa de snyed/ rang rig bde ba chen po dang*| tha dad med par 'char ba 'byung la/ gal te goms 'dris chung ba sogs kyis de ltar snang sems tha mi dad du mnyam par 'jog tu ma nus na/ brtan g.yo tshogs drug gi snang ba thams cad rang lhar gsal ba la bsdu/ de yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ la hūm̐ nā da'i bar du bsdus nas/ nā da yang je phrar gyur nas ci yang mi dmigs pa'i ngang du ci gnas su bcos so// ma bcos lhug pa rang babs su bzhag nas rim gyis snga ma ltar mnyam du byas la bsgom par bya'o// thun mtshams rnams su bsngo bas rgyas 'debs shing dus thams cad du 'bad med du bsgoms pas rab tshe 'dir mchog gi grub pa thob/ 'bring 'chi ba'i tshe 'od gsal chos kyi skur sangs rgyas/ tha mas kyang bar dor dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis bsus te 'og min bde ba chen po'i zhing khams su longs sku nges pa lnga ldan du 'tshang mi rgya ba mi srid pa'i gdams pa dril bu'i rim lngar grags pa chad pa'i skyon med cing shin tu bsdus par bgyis pa'i skabs so// // ༈ /yang dgyes pa rdo rje'i rdzogs rim grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po nā ro pa'i gdams pa chos drug tu grags pa nyams su blang ba la'ang*/ sngon 'gro sngar ltar la/ khyad par gyi sngon 'gro rtsa rlung thig le sbyang ba gsum las/ rtsa sbyang ba ni/ rang dgyes pa rdo rje dpa' bo gcig par gsal ba'i spyi bo nas gsang gnas bar du rtsa dbu ma pad+ma rā ga'i mdog lta bu/ g.yas su ro ma dmar po/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar po gnyis yar sne klad rgya'i steng nas sna bug gnyis su zug pa/ mar sne yi ge cha ltar gsang gnas nas dbu ma'i nang du tshud pa/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhir gyes pa/

snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo 'dab ma brgyad/ mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo 'dab ma bcu drug /spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo 'dab ma so gnyis pa/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi rnams drang ba/ phra ba/ rkyang ma ma gtogs dmar por gsal ba ste mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du bsam mo// rlung sbyang ba ni/ lus bsam gtan gyi chos drug dang*/ lag pa rdo rje'i khu tshur pus steng so sor bzhag nas 'bud pa dgu phrugs byas la phyir bus pa'i tshe sdig sgrib sang sang dag /nang du rngub pa'i tshe sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi byin rlabs bsdus par bsam/ de nas sgra med du sna bug gnyis nas dal bus brngub/ mchil ma zhig dang mnyam du lte 'og hril gyis dgang*| de'i tshe rgyab rlung cung zad yar bsdams la bum can ci thub bzung*/ mi thub la nye ba'i tshe lus g.yas g.yon du cung zad nem nem gyis rtsa mig tu gzhil la bzung*/ mi thub pa'i tshe cung zad phyir btang la mnan nas bzung*/ dal bus sangs kyis sna bug nas btang la mjug tu dbyings rig bsre/ rlung rngub pa dang gtong ba mtha' dag kha nas ma song ba shin tu gal che| thig le sbyang ba ni/ smin mtshams su thig le sngon po sran ma tsam zhig bzung*/ gnas pa rlung rngub pa'i tshe dbu ma'i nang nas gsang ba'i bar spro// dgang zhing gzhil ba'i tshe rtsa 'khor rnams su sing sgra dang bcas myur bar bsdu/ rlung gtong ba'i tshe phyir bton par bsam mo// skabs 'dir spro na nā ro'i drug skor lag len ltar bya/ de ltar rtsa rlung thig le'i lam 'byongs nas dngos gzhi nyams su blang ba ni/ rtsa ba'i chos bzhi dang*/ yan lag gi chos gnyis las/ dang po 'dzag bcas 'jig rten pa'i lhan skyes kyi gnyen por gtum mo lam gyi gzhung shing nyams su blang ba ni/ rkang pa tsog pur bsnol/ lag pa mnyam gzhag gi pus 'khyud/ gzhan bsam gtan gyi yan lag drug po 'dra/ rab gnas dang ldan pa'i sgom thag bcings|

skyabs sems dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsal btab/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī don nyams su myong bar gsol ba btab/ rang la bstim/ nyams len gyi thog ma gtum mo ma zin pa 'dzin pa ni/ rtsa gsum 'dus mdor lte 'og sor bzhi'i ro rkyang gi sne mo'i steng du chos 'byung dmar po'i dbus gtum mo'i a shad kyi rnam pa'i rang bzhin sra zhing gzhom gzhig dang bral ba/ chu'i dwangs ma dmar cha'i dwangs ma rlan zhing gsher ba/ me'i rang bzhin rno zhing tsha ba sreg pa'i ngar can/ rlung gi rang bzhin g.yo zhing kun tu khyab pa/ gzhan yang kha dog dmar ba/ reg bya tsha ba/ ngo bo bde ba/ rtse mo rno zhing 'khyog pa'i rnam pa can du bsam mo// zin pa brtan par bya ba ni/ nam mkha'i rlung zhes mnyam rgyu'i skabs/ rlung sbyong ba'i skabs ltar bum can mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du bzung ba'i tshe/ ro rkyang nas srog rtsol gyi sbud pas a shad la bsnun ma thag de las me cher bus nas dbu ma'i nang du 'bar ba'i me lce yang gong ltar mtshan nyid bzhi ldan mnyam par bzhag go// brtan pa bogs 'don la/ drod/ bde ba/ mi rtog pa gsum las/ drod bogs 'don ni/ gong ltar rlung bzung bas me ches cher 'bar bas rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi lus kyi phyi nang thams cad gang bar bsam/ spro na drod kyi 'khrul 'khor bya/ lus rngul na sran phyes 'phur ba sogs man ngag ltar dang*/ so bdun ma'i 'khrul 'khor bya'o// yang rlung bzung bas me ches cher 'bar bas stong gsum me lce gcig tu 'bar bar bsam mo// 'di'i skabs gtum mo'i bde drod kyi lang tsho ngom zhing gos kyi 'khri ba gcod pa'i phyir ras 'bud bya ba ni/ rab lta ba gnyis med zung 'jug rtogs pa/ 'bring dmigs pa yul gsum rang dbang chub pa/ tha mas ni 'di ltar khrus bya/ bgegs bskrad/ srung 'khor bsgom/ shis brjod bya/ dmigs pa mal stan me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum 'bar ba'i steng du rang lus lcags bsregs pa lta bu/

lag gnyis g.yas 'og /g.yon steng nyi dkyil me 'bar bar bsam/ snod bcud kyi me rnams bsdus pa lte 'og sor bzhir bya sgong tsam la thim par sems gtad/ ras rkyang bgo bas seng ge'i nyal stabs su mgo byang la bstan la bde bar nyal/ drod dka' na rje btsun rat+na'i dag pa'i snang ba gtum mo tsaṇ+ḍa li'i dmigs pa bcud bzhi'i 'phul gcig gi 'khrul 'khor dang bcas pa bla ma'i zhal rgyun ltar bya/ chu ras sogs kyi skabs su bab na bya ba yin no// bde ba bogs 'don pa ni lus gnad rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi gtum mo sngar ltar la/ snying khar dbus su buṃ/ phyogs bzhir aṃ dz+rīṃ khaṃ hūm̐/ mgrin par dbus su māṃ/ phyogs bzhir lāṃ pāṃ tāṃ āṃ rnams rtsa mdud kyi rnam pa/ spyi bor dkar cha'i dwangs ma haṃ yig mgo thur bstan du yod par bsam/ rlung bzung bas a shad las me 'bar bas g.yon rkyang ma zla ba'i rgyu ba bkag /g.yas ro ma'i nang du 'bar bas snying gi rtsa mdud lnga po bkrol/ mes g.yas ro ma'i nyi ma'i rgyu ba bkag /g.yon rkyang ma'i nang du 'bar bas/ mgrin pa'i rtsa mdud lnga po bkrol/ me lces g.yas g.yon ro rkyang gi nyi zla'i rgyu ba bkag /dbu ma'i nang du mar bab a shad la thim la khad sor bzhi tsam 'bar ba la sems gtad/ yang rlung bzung bas sbud nas me cher 'bar/ dbu ma'i nang brgyud 'khor lo bzhi rim gyis bsgrod pas haṃ la reg pas haṃ las dkar cha shar gyis bab pa/ me lce la reg la khad du nye ba na je dma' dang dkar cha je ring du 'bros 'ded byas pas thur du bab pa'i tshe/ mgrin par byang sems slebs pa dga' ba/ snying khar mchog dga'/ lte bar dga' bral/ gsang bar lhan skyes mnyam par bzhag /yang rlung gi sbyor bas a shad la me sbar ba'i tshe me lce je ring dang dkar cha je thung gyen la 'dzegs pa'i tshe/ lte bar dga' ba/ snying khar mchog dga'/ mgrin par dga' bral/ spyi bor lhan skyes la mnyam par bzhag

/'di'i skabs bde ba 'bar bas byang sems 'phor nye na/ gsum chos kyi gnad ni/ bde nyams nyon mongs kyi rtog pa gtsir gyis bzung*/ gzhu bdung pa'i yun tsam lam du btang*/ slar sher snying klog pa'i yun tsam de'i ngo bor bltas la gnad du dbab/ de nas byang chub kyi sems yud tsam bsgoms pas dug la sngags btab pas sman du 'gyur ba ltar/ byang chub sems gnyis dang bde ba ro gcig tu gyur pas gnas skabs su sangs rgyas byang sems mang po zhal mthong zhing mthar thug 'dod chags dag /pad+ma'i rigs su 'tshang rgya ba'i dgos pa yod/ de rjes lus slar gsal btab pa ba spu'i khung bu tshun la khrems par bkram pas yon tan dang dngos grub thams cad myur du thob par 'gyur bar gsungs so// rkang pa 'khum pa sogs byung na gtum mo'i sku bsring ba man ngag ltar bya'o// gzhan yang rje rin po che'i man ngag ni/ lte 'og rtsa gsum 'dus mdor thig le dkar zhing dmar mdangs chags pa snum la 'dril ba bde ba'i rang bzhin bya sgong tsam zhig bsgom/ de la goms nas de 'dra ba brgyad dang bcu drug tu gyes par bsgom/ de la goms nas de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa gyes par yang bsgom/ mthar thig le thams cad rtsa ba'i thig le la thim par bsams pas bde drod mi bzod pa 'byung bar gsungs so// 'di'i tshe drod shas chung na drod bogs 'don/ bde ba shas chung na bde ba bogs 'don sogs skabs su gang bab brtson par bya'o// mi rtog pa bogs 'don pa ni/ rang lhar gsal ba rjes gzhig gam ril 'dzin gyis bsdus nas/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi sogs kyang mi dmigs par gang shar 'dzin med gnyen po der 'dzin gyi bcos lhad med par gcer yan du bde stong lhan skyes kyi ngo bo 'dzin med yeng med du bskyang ngo*// de ltar rtsa rlung thig le gnad du bsnun pas rtsa thams cad rlung dang thig les khyab cing*/ bde drod mi rtog pa'i ye shes myur du rgyud la skye bar 'gyur ro// gtum mo'i dam tshig tu/

rkang rjen mi bya/ dung mi 'bud/ chu mi brgal/ 'khyag pa yid la mi bya/ lan tshwa sgog btsong rul sung can gyi zas dang tsha skyur gyi btung ba mang ba spang ngo*// bde drod gyi gegs su gyur pa rnams la 'dzem mo// de ltar lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo la brten nas gtum mo la gnad du bsnun pas 'pho ba'i gnas skabs kyi dri ma dag nas don dam ye shes rdo rje'i skur 'tshang rgya ba yin no// gnyis pa sems rang bzhin gyi rmongs pa'i gnyen por 'od gsal lam gyi sgron me nyams su blang ba ni/ dben par mtshams bcad khrus dang sku mnye bya/ grib la 'dzem/ zas bcud can bsten/ lus ngag yid gsum rnam g.yeng spangs la/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul/ 'od gsal zin pa'i grogs bcol/ zhag gsum gnyid spangs/ nyin par dang srod la gtum mo bsgom/ nam gung dang tho rangs la bab pa'i tshe lus lhar bsgoms pa'i nang du rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi gsal btab/ spyi bor bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms nas bdag do nub rmi lam mi rmi bar 'od gsal zin pa'i gsol ba btab nas rang la bsdu/ rang gi snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus dbu ma'i nang du pad+ma sngon po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte ba'i nyi ma'i steng du/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku chung la dod cing gsal ba snang la rang bzhin med pa 'od 'phro ba'i 'od kyis lus phyi nang med pa gang ste/ shel bum gyi nang du mar me bcug pa lta bu bsam pa'i ngang nas bla ma'i sku la sems ma yeng bar gtad la 'jam rlung bum pa can bzung*/ mgo byang du blta bas seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis nyal/ rnam rtog 'phro na lus snang thams cad 'od kyi rnam par bsdus nas bla ma'i sku la bstim/ des zin/ yang na bla ma'i thugs kar pad+ma sngon po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing ga 'od 'phro ba la sems gtad/ gzhan gong dang 'dra/ yang bla ma'i thugs kar pad+ma'i lte bar 'od kyi thig le sngon po yungs 'bru tsam la sems gtad la bsgom mo// de ltar 'bad pas cis kyang zin par 'gyur ro// 'od gsal zin nas bogs 'don pa ni/

thog mar 'od gsal ngos bzung ste/ gzhi'i 'od gsal ni/ sems rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba nyid do// lam gyi 'od gsal la nyams dang rtog pa gnyis te/ nyams kyi 'od gsal ni gnyid kyi ngang rnam rtog cher med pa/ lus phyi nang gnas khang yo byad sogs mthong ba nyi zla shar ba lta bu stong nyid kyi gzugs tsam po ba mthong ba'o// rtog pa'i 'od gsal ni gnyid kyi snang mched thob gsum sogs ngos zin pa'i mthar nyer thob 'od gsal la thim ma thag gnyid mthug med pa 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bu gsal dwangs zung 'jug tu 'char ba yin no// 'bras bu'i 'od gsal la/ spyi don gyi 'od gsal ni/ sangs rgyas pa'i thugs zab gsal gnyis med kyi 'od gsal de nyid yin la/ sbas don gyi 'od gsal ni/ 'chi ba'i thim rim gyi tha mar 'chi ba 'od gsal chos skur 'tshang rgya ba de nyid yin no// de nyid nyams myong gis bogs dbyung ba ni/ nyin par gtum mo bsgom/ de'i nyams myong bde drod kyi ting nge 'dzin rang bzhin spros bral du rtogs pa de dang*/ mtshan mo'i gnyid 'od gsal zung 'jug tu bsgom/ yang mtshan mo'i 'od gsal des nyin snang gi dge sbyor la rgyas btab ste sgom pa sogs bla ma'i man ngag gi gnad dang sbyor ba yin no| |de ltar snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo la brten nas 'od gsal la gnad du bsnun pas gnyid mthug gi gti mug gi gnas skabs kyi dri ma dag nas/ rab tshe 'di'am tha mas 'chi ba 'od gsal lam du bslangs nas chos kyi skur 'tshang rgya ba yin no// gsum pa bag chags nying 'khrul gyi gnyen por rmi lam gyi tshod 'dzin nyams su blang ba la'ang*/ sbyor chos 'od gsal dang 'dra ba la 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pas gang gis kyang dgos pa med snyam pa rtag tu bsam zhing ngag tu yang brjod/ nyin par gtum mo sgom zhing de'i rjes thob nyin snang thams cad rmi lam yin snyam du sbyang*/ de nas 'dzin pa dngos ni/

rang lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor bla ma bsgoms/ mchod nas rmi lam 'od gsal zin par gsol ba btab/ rang la bstim/ srog thur gyi rlung bum can lan gsum bzung*/ do nub rmi lam la rmi lam du shes par bya snyam pa byas la/ rang lhar gsal ba'i nang du rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi gsal ba'i mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab dbus ma'i nang du gdan bzhi brtsegs kyi steng du bla ma rdo rje 'chang 'od 'phro ba gsal ba'i bla mas kyang*/ chos thams cad rmi lam yin zhes gsung bzhin pa/ bla ma'i mgrin par pad+ma sngon po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar oṃ dkar po/ mdun gyi 'dab mar a sngon po/ g.yas su nu ser po/ rgyab tu ta dmar po/ g.yon du ra ljang gu bsam/ seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis mgo byang du bstan/ 'jam rlung bum pa can bdun bzung la/ thog mar mdun gyi a la sems gtad/ gnyid bro ba'i tshe nu la sems gtad/ cher bro ba'i tshe ta la| ches cher 'thib pa'i tshe ra dang*/ gnyid du 'gro khar oṃ la sems ma yeng bar gtad/ rtog pa gzhan gyis bar ma chod par sems gtad na gnyid zin par 'gyur ro// des ma zin na rang lhar gsal ba'i smin mtshams su zla dkyil thig le dkar po sran ma tsam gyi mtshan pa la sems bzung*/ des kyang ma zin na rang gi 'og tu thig le dmar po dang dkar po gnyis gsal ba chu nang du rdo bskyur ba'i ri mo ltar je cher song nas ga'u ltar gyur pa'i nang du rang gnas par bsam/ 'di rnams la 'jam rlung dang lus gnad sogs snga ma ltar bya'o// de ltar byas pas rmi lam zin pa'i rtags ni/ rmi lam bzang ngan gang rmis thams cad rmi lam du 'dug snyam nges tsir tsir zin pa de ga yin no// rmi lam zin 'phror sad na nyin snang du thun mthar sad par bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa btang*/ nyal ba'i tshe nor bu'i rtser thig le nag po sran ma tsam la sems gtad/ rlung bum can nyer gcig bya/ yang rmi lam re gnyis tsam zin nas gzhan nying 'khrul du song na/

nyin mo ci nas kyang ma 'khrul bar bya snyam du bsam/ rmi lam zin ma thag 'jam rlung bum can bzung bar bya'o// zin cing brtan par gyur nas sbyang ba ni/ 'di rmi lam yin pas ji ltar byas kyang btub snyam du bsam nas nyi zlar zhon nas dga' ldan du 'gro ba dang*/ dag pa'i zhing gzhan dang rigs drug gi gnas sogs su blta bar 'gro ba dang*/ dag pa'i zhing du rgyal ba rnams mjal zhing chos nyan pa sogs rnam pa sna tshogs la bslab bo// 'byongs nas spel ba ni/ rmi lam gyi snang ba de dag gcig las du mar spel ba dang*/ du ma gcig tu bsgyur la bslab| de goms nas bsgyur ba ni/ rmi lam gyi brtan g.yo rnams bla mar bsgyur nas chos zhu ba dang*/ yi dam du bsgyur nas dngos grub blang ba sogs bya'o// de goms nas ya nga ba spangs shing sgyu mar bslab pa ni/ rmi lam de thams cad ni snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu mar sbyangs shing me chu g.yang sar mchong ba dang*/ nam mkha' la 'phur ba dang*/ mi phod pa thams cad thog brdzis bya'o// rmi lam gyi de kho na nyid ni/ nyin snang thams cad rmi lam lta bu/ rmi lam yang nyin snang lta bu/ de thams cad rang sems kyi cho 'phrul 'ba' zhig tu shes shing rtogs par byas nas nyin mtshan gyi yul snang thams cad sgyu ma ltar go bas/ sems mi rtog pa don dam mchog gi gtum mo las rnam pa kun tu mi g.yo bar ting nge 'dzin gyis dus 'da' bar bya'o// de ltar mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo la brten nas rmi lam gnad du bsnun pas bag chags nying 'khrul gnas skabs kyi dri ma dag nas longs sku nges pa lnga ldan du 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro// bzhi pa snang ba bden 'dzin gyi gnyen po sgyu lus lam gyi gzhi ma nyams su blang ba ni/ gnas dben par dkon mchog gsum dang*/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong la gtor mchod phul nas/ chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur myur du rtogs par gsol ba btab/

mtshams bcad nas thog mar ma dag pa'i sgyu lus sgyu mar sbyang ba la/ lus sgyu mar sbyang ba ni/ rang gi mdun du shing khru gang par me long dri bral btags pa'i nang du rang gi bzhin ras shar ba la bltas nas/ res bstod res smad pas de la dga' ba dang mi dga'i snang ba ci 'dug blta/ res 'ga' bzhin ras de me long las byung ngam/ bzhin ras las byung*/ me long las byung na ni bzhin ras de sbas pa'i tshe bzhin ras me long du mi snang*/ bzhin ras las byung na ni me long med na mdun gyi bzhin ras mi snang bas ji ltar yin brtag /'on te yul yul can tshogs pa las med bzhin du snang bar sbyangs/ de la sogs pa'i tshul du mas sbyangs shing*/ de yang sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyi gtso bo med bzhin du snang ba me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu/ rgyu rkyen tshogs pa las snang yang rang bzhin ma grub pa nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon lta bu/ gcig las du mar snang zhing ngos bzung dang bral ba chu nang gi zla ba lta bu ste/ dpe'i gtso bo gsum gyis mtshon nas shes par sbyangs shing*/ ngag sgyu mar bslab pa ni/ brag dben pa'i rtsar phyin nas bos shing lab pa'i tshe/ rang gi ji ltar smras pa de nyid las sgra che zhing gsal bar tshur smra ba ltar snang yang*/ de ni brag cha las kyang ma byung*/ rang kho na'i ngag las kyang ma byung bar med bzhin tu smra ba/ smras ma thag tu stong pa'i rang sgra/ grag tsam nyid nas ngo bo stong pa/ sgyu ma mkhan gyis sprul pa'i mis tshig brjod pa'am/ rmi lam gyi ngag ltar grag stong sgyu mar sbyangs shing bslab bo// sems sgyu mar bslab pa ni/ dper na nam mkha' 'di rgyu rkyen gang gis kyang ma skyes/ bar gang du yang mi gnas/ mthar gang du yang mi 'gags/ nam mkha' zhes ming tsam yang ngo bo stong zhing rnam pa gsal ba kha dog sngon po sogs lhun po'i phyogs kyi mdog gis bsgyur bas gang du yang bsgyur du btub pa/

sprin la sogs pa sna tshogs pa'i snang ba ltar 'dug kyang*/ ngo bo la 'gyur ba med pa gsal zhing stong pa/ stong tsam nas gsal zhing snang ba/ de gnyis kyang rgyud tha mi dad par zung du 'jug pa ltar rang sems kyang ngo bo ngos bzung dang bral ba/ sems byung rnam rtog sna tshogs 'phro yang sems las logs su ma grub pa/ tshogs drug gi yul du ma snang yang rang rang gi ngo bos stong pa/ sems las gzhan du med pa/ dper na sgyu ma mkhan gyis rta glang shing rta brtan g.yo ji snyed cig sprul pa 'khrul ngor med bzhin du snang yang*/ rtsa ba sgyu ma mkhan rang nyid kyis byas pa ma gtogs gzhan gang yang med pa sogs dpe du mas sems snang thams cad sgyu mar sbyang*/ 'byongs nas nyin mtshan gyi snang ba tshogs drug la sogs pa 'khor 'das kyi chos dang chos can thams cad sgyu ma'i dpes mtshon nas sgyu ma'i rnam par thar pa nyid du sbyang bar bya'o// dag pa'i sgyu lus sgyu mar sbyang ba ni/ rang gi rgyab tu lha'i sku dang zhal phyag phyogs log pa zhig gzhal yas khang gi nang du yod pa bris pa bshams/ de 'char ba'i me long mdun du bzhag /'gying log med na mdun du bris sku bkram/ de'i gzugs rang gi rgyab tu me long che ba gcig la 'char bar bya/ de'i gzugs mdun gyi me long la 'char bar byas la/ gong ltar de'i snang brnyan rten dang brten par bcas pa med bzhin snang ba me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu/ kha dog gsal yang ngo bo ma grub pa 'ja' tshon lta bu/ du mar khyab yang chu zla lta bu sogs sgyu ma'i dpes mtshon nas/ sgyu ma lta bur bsam zhing sbyangs/ thun mtshams sogs thams cad du gzugs su snang ba thams cad lha'i sku gsal stong sgyu ma lta bu/ sgrar grag pa thams cad sngags kyi rang sgra grag stong sgyu ma lta bu/ sems kyi dran rtog thams cad thugs ting nge 'dzin gsal stong sgyu ma lta bur bslab cing sbyangs pas chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa zhes bya ba/

gang zag dang chos kyi bdag med gcig du bral sogs lung rig rtog brtags tha snyad mkhan po'i 'khrul rlom cal sgrog la ltos mi dgos par/ snang srid sgyu ma lta bur shar bas snang sems tha dad med par rtogs par 'gyur ba yin no// de ltar spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo la brten nas sgyu lus la gnad du bsnun nas sad pa'i gnas skabs kyi dri ma dag nas sprul pa'i skur 'tshang rgya ba yin no// lnga pa dang drug pa las rgya myur lam pho nya'i lam gong du 'pho ba dang*/ bar do'i gdams pa gnyis las/ thog mar lam gyi bsu skyel 'pho ba'i gdams pa ni gsum/ dbang po rab kyis nyin chos thams cad rjes gzhig dang ril 'dzin gyi stong pa gzhir bsdus pa'i tha ma 'od gsal ba dang*/ btsan thabs rdo rje'i rba rlabs bcings pa'i sbyor bas srog rtsol 'gags pa'i thim rim ngos bzung ba'i mthar gnyid mthug gi 'od gsal la 'dris par byas pa dag gis 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa'i tshe/ rags pa dang phra ba shin tu phra ba'i thim rim ngos bzung nas 'chi ba'i 'od gsal shar ma thag ngos bzung nas de dang sngar sbyangs pa'i 'od gsal tha mi dad du rtogs pas bar ma dor brgyud ma dgos pa skad cig dang por chos kyi skur 'tshang rgya'o| |dbang po 'bring gis nyin snang 'od gsal stong pa nyid las lha'i skur ldang ba dang*/ btsan thabs su rba rlabs bcings nas srog 'gags pa'i 'od gsal gyi ngang nas srog rtsol cung zad rgyu bas rnam rtog phra ba nas ldang ba'i tshe/ lha'i skur bsgoms shing gnyid kyi 'od gsal kho nar gnas ma thub pas/ rlung g.yos pas rmi lam gyi 'khrul pa cung zad 'go rtsom pa'i tshe de nyid rmi lam du shes nas sprul bsgyur gyi gdams pas lha skur ldang ba la goms pas/ 'chi ba 'od gsal ngos bzung nas snang mched thob pa 'od gsal las rlung dang bsdong nas g.yo zhing ldang bar nye ba'i tshe/ lha sku sgyu ma lta bu skad cig la shar nas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur 'tshang rgya ba yin no// dbang po tha ma 'od gsal dang sgyu lus gnyis ka la sgom blo byas kyang brtan pa ma thob pa dag ni sprul skur 'pho bas mtshams sbyor ba ste/

'di la sbyang ba dang las la sbyor ba gnyis las/ sbyang ba ni/ gnas dben par rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan pas spyi bor bla ma bsgoms/ 'pho ba'i lam 'byong bar gsol ba btab/ rang la bstim/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i khong par spyi bo nas gsang gnas bar ka ba btsugs pa lta bu'i thad kyi nang du āḥdamar po/ snying khar sems kyi ngo bo hūm̐ nag po/ spyi bo'i tshangs bug tu k+ṣa dkar pos bkag par bsam/ steng rlung rngub cing rgyab rlung 'then la bum pa kha sbyor bya/ slar rlung gnyis ka gyen du ches cher drangs shing rlung dmigs sems gsum k+ṣa la gtad pas srog thur gyi rlung steng du 'ongs bas lte ba'i āḥgayos gyen du sbud pas dbu ma'i nang brgyud hūm̐ la thug pas hūm̐ phul nas gyen du 'phos pas spyi bo'i k+ṣa phul nas steng du thon la khad du bsam rlung ma thub pa'i tshe hūm̐ dang k+ṣa rang sar phab/ de 'dra ba thun re rer rlung drag po bum can sgang dril nyer gcig re las mi nyung ba bsgom/ mthar bsngo ba bya/ 'byongs rtags spyi ltar bya/ 'byongs nas thun rer ma brjed pa dran tsam re bya/ cher mi bsgom mo// las la sbyar ba ni/ 'chi bar nges shing dus la bab pa'i tshe thim rim rnams ngos bzung*/ yo byad la ma chags par dkon mchog gsum gyi phyogs su btang*/ 'pho ba'i dmigs pa sbyangs/ 'chi ba'i skabs ltar yang yang gsal btab/ 'chi ba la thug pa'i tshe/ lus gnad tsog pu'am/ chos bdun nam/ seng ge'i nyal stabs sam/ grogs kyis skyor ba gang bde'i ngang nas rang lus yi dam gyi nang nas dbu ma thig le dang bcas pa gsal btab/ spyi bo'i 'dom gang tsam du rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog gsum kun 'dus pa'i bdag nyid yi dam gyi sku'i rnam par bsgoms/ mchod cing 'chi ba lam du slong bar gsol ba btab/ dbang bzhi blang*/ rang la mi bsdu bar de nyid du gsal ba'i ngang nas srog rtsol gyi rlung shin tu drag po stod du 'then pa'i ngang nas āḥhig drag po bcu gcig brjod pas lte ba'i āḥgyen du drag por 'phos pas snying ga'i hūm̐ la bstim/

de ma thag rlung rtsol dang āḥhig drag po bcu gcig gis rlung cher g.yos nas mgrin par slebs/ yang rlung dang āḥhig drag po lnga brjod pas hūm̐ spyi bo'i k+ṣa la reg ma thag k+ṣa rang bzhin med par yal nas hūm̐ tshangs bug tu thon par bsam/ slar rlung dang āḥhig drag po mang du brjod pas hūm̐ skar mda' ltar song bas yi dam gyi thugs kar thim par bsam zhing rlung dang āḥhig drag la mang bas 'pho/ rang gis ma nus na grogs kyis āḥhig drag la mang bar brjod cing rang gis rlung dmigs la 'bad/ lus la phyi mig mi blta ba gnad che/ 'phos zin nas bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag go// gzhan la 'debs pa'i tshul ni de nyid man ngag gnad dang ldan par sbyar ro// tshul 'di ni ma bsgom yang dbang po rab 'bring tha ma gsum sku gsum du 'tshang rgya ba'i myur lam ma bsgom sangs rgyas 'pho ba'i gdams pa zhes bya'o| |drug pa lam gyi blo chos bar do'i gdams pa ni/ 'chi ba'i rtags rnams ngos bzung nas 'chi ba la thug pa'i tshe chags zhen med cing 'chi ba la brod pa'i ngang nas rang lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor bla ma bsgom/ mchod nas bar do lam du lhong bar gsol ba btab/ rang la bstim/ 'chi ba la thug pa'i tshe/ thog mar snang mched thob gsum thim pa ngos bzung nas/ nyer thob 'od gsal la thim ma thag 'od gsal ngos bzung zhing 'od gsal gyi ngang nas mnyam par bzhag /'di la ji tsam sdod kyang rang dbang yod pas de'i ngang du grol bar bya'o// de tsam mi nus na 'od gsal de'i ngang nas lha sku sgyu ma lta bur ldang ba'i sbyor ba bya/ de yang mi nus na bar do'i gdams pas 'di ltar nyams su blangs te/ gang zag rab tshe 'dir 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po la 'dris pa dag gis bar dor 'jug bya dgag pa ni/ bdag shi ba dang gnas grogs lus sogs bar do yin par ngo shes par byas nas/

rang lha skur bsgoms la rjes gzhig gam ril 'dzin gang rung gi 'od gsal stong nyid phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag pas mngal du 'jug bya kheg par 'gyur ro// de tsam mi nus na gang zag 'bring tshe 'dir bskyed rim la 'dris pa dag gis bar dor/ rang phor skye na pho la sdang zhing mo la chags pa dang*/ mor skyes na de las log pa'i snang ba dang*/ pho mo 'du 'phrod byed pa mthong na de la chags sdang mig ser 'byung ba de'i tshe/ bdag sngon yang chags sdang byas pas 'khor bar 'khor ba yin/ da ni chags sdang mi bya'o snyam pa'i dran pas gsos btab/ des ma zhi na pho mo gnyis bla ma yab yum du bsgoms nas gsang ba'i dbang zhu bar bsam/ des kyang ma kheg na bla ma yi dam yab yum sogs snang srid 'khor 'das/ chos thams cad med bzhin du snang ba rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu yin mod/ sngon chad kyang de ltar ma rtogs pas 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin/ da ni yang dag pa'i bden pa 'khor 'das dbyer med rig grol rang shar de kho na nyid 'di la mnyam par gzhag par bya'o snyam du blos byas kyis nyams su blang*/ des bdun phrag dang po'i mngal sgo kheg par 'gyur/ bdun phrag phyi ma rnams su yang tshul de ltar 'bad pas mngal sgo kheg pa la tshegs med pa yin no// gang zag tha ma lam rim pa gnyis la goms pa chung ba dag gis mngal ma kheg na mngal 'dam nas chos sgrub pa'i rten bzung ba ni/ bar dor gnas pa'i tshe sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag bar do 'di nas 'phos te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing bde ba can la sogs par ci nas kyang skye ba'i nying mtshams sbyar bar bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag pos mtshams sbyar ro// de tsam mi nus na bdag sems can gyi don nus pa'i rigs rnam par dag cing gtsang bar skye ba'i nying mtshams sbyor gyi/ ma dag pa rnams su mi skye'o snyam pa'i 'phen pa bya zhing*/ skabs 'dir ma'i mngal dngos su mi mthong bas 'jigs skrag gi snang bas 'bros par brtsam pa'i tshe/

gnas ngan pa mi gtsang ba'i 'dam dang sa phug gad khung gcong rong la sogs pa gnas ngan skyugs bro ba rnams su mi 'gro bar/ lha khang mchod rten pho brang la sogs par 'gro bar brtsams pas mi'i lus rten chos sgrub nus pa rigs mtho zhing gtsang mar skye ba ste/ 'di'i nyams len tha ma bar dor lus ngan spangs zhing lus bzang po len pa'i thabs mngal 'dam pa'i sbyor ba zhes bya ba ste bar dor grol ba'i gdams pa yin te/ 'di la yang goms pa sngon du 'gro dgos pas nyin mtshan gyi snang ba bar dor bsgoms nas/ rab 'od gsal/ 'bring sgyu lus/ tha mas mngal dgag pa/ de tsam mi nus kyang mngal 'dam pa'i sbyor ba/ blos byas kyi sgo nas sbyangs shing 'dris pas goms pa lhur bya ba gal che'o// rjes ni dus thams cad du mnyam gzhag gi gtso bor gtum mo sgom/ rjes thob kyi sgyu lus kyi chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur sbyang*/ mtshan mo gnyid mthug gi 'od gsal dang bag chags rmi lam 'khrul par ldang na rmi lam sbyang*/ skabs su 'pho ba dang thun mtshams rnams su bar do sbyangs bas rab tshe 'dir/ 'bring 'chi ba'i tshe/ tha mas kyang bar dor mchog gi dngos grub zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang mi thob mi srid do// zhes pa ni/ zab lam nā ro'i chos drug mar lugs kyi gdams pa ma tshang ba med cing tshig mdor bsdus nas bshad pa'i skabs so/// / ༈ /yang gnyis med dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdzogs rim kasmi rī som nā tha'i lugs sbyor ba yan lag drug la'ang thun mong dang*/ thun mong min pa'i sngon 'gro sngar ltar la/ khyad par gyi sngon 'gro dben gsum ni/ lus ngag yid gsum 'jig rten dang mthun pa'i rnam g.yeng dang*/ chos kyi bskyed rim sngags dang chos spyod bsam gtan sogs gang yang mi byed par khyab gdal du zo glod par zhag bdun sogs bya'o// dngos gzhi la sbyor ba yan lag drug pa sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rnal 'byor thog mtha' bar gsum du dge ba las|

dang po thog mar dge ba sku rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la so sor bsam pa gnyis kyi dang po so sor sdud pa ni/ lus gnad rkang pa rdor skyil/ lag gnyis rdo rje'i khu tshur so sor bsgrengs pa brla khud du kha sbub/ gzhan bsam gtan gyi yan lag spyi ltar la/ lta stangs rdo rje gtsug tor lta ba zhes pa sna rtse nas sor nyi shu gyen du 'phags pa'i thad kyi bar snang la mig bsgrad nas/ rang dus 'khor dpa' bo gcig par bsams pa'i ngang nas/ rnal 'byor dngos la mtshan mo bla gab dang bcas pa'i mun pa'i khang bur sems rab tu g.yo ba 'di mdun gyi lta stangs la gtad nas bsgrims te bsgom/ yang nyin mo bla gab med pa ni/ snga dro nub dang phyi dro shar tu phyogs pas lus gnad lta stangs sgom tshul sogs gong ma ltar res 'ga' mdun gyi nam mkha' sprin med pa la sems 'dzin/ res 'ga' mdun gyi ri rtse dang nam mkha'i mtshams su sems bzung*/ 'di dag gi tshe 'og rlung cung zad 'then no// de ltar nyin mtshan gnyis su bcad nas nyams su blangs pas du ba la sogs pa'i rtags bcu 'char/ gal te 'char dka' na spog pa'i cho ga dang bying rgod na ba sogs byung na gegs sel rgyas pa sogs khrid gzhung na gsal lo// rtags bcu las/ mtshan ltas du ba/ smig rgyu/ nam mkha'/ mar me lta bu ste bzhi/ nyin ltas 'bar ba/ zla ba/ nyi ma/ rdo rje cha dang*/ thig le lta bu ste drug 'char ro// des ni dbang po dang tshor ba dang drug |rtsa ba dang yan lag gi rlung gis g.yos pa der 'dzin 'khrul blor 'phyan pa bkag cing*/ 'od lnga sgra gcan thig le thig phran sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan la sogs par snang ba'i rtags dang*| rtags can bden tshig grub cing mchog sbyin nus pa dang*/ 'di skabs shi na'ang lus bzang po blangs te/ lam gyi 'phro mthud pas skye ba bdun la sangs rgyas thob la/ mthar thug rdo rje sems dpa' gdan gsum tshang ba'i go 'phang 'grub par byed do// gnyis pa sor sdud kyi ngo bo brtan byed bsam gtan bsgom pa ni/

lus gnad snga ma lta bus bsam gtan lnga bsgoms te/ du ba sogs rtags gang rung mthong ba ni shes rab/ de la der 'dzin gyi 'khrul blo med par mngon sum du mthong ba rtogs pa/ stong gzugs de gcig nas du ma'i bar du shar yang 'dzin pa med pa spyod pa/ phyi yi stong gzugs de rnams dang nang gi sems dbyer med du rtogs pa dga' ba/ dbyer med ro gcig rtogs snang shar yang 'dzin med du 'jog cing byan tshud pa ni g.yo med kyi bde ba ste/ de ltar chos lnga pos gzugs/ sgra/ dri/ ro/ reg bya/ chos/ phyi nang gi tshogs drug stong gzugs thams cad tshul de lngas gnad du bsnun nas bsgom pa yin no// de la nyams myong skyes nas bogs 'don pa ni/ thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas 'don dgos te/ nyin mo sor sdud kyi skabs ltar nam mkha' la gtad nas stong gzugs la sems 'dzin/ de rjes lta stangs dang stong gzugs mar phab nas mdun gyi ka ba sogs la sems bzung*/ las snang de dag stong gzugs su shar zhing stong gzugs kyang yul yul can dbyer med du ma rtogs kyi bar sbyang*/ mtshan mo sna bug gi rlung la sems gtad nas bsgom/ yang mtshan mo rang lha stong rar gsal ba'i khong dbus rtsa dbu ma sngon po yas sne tshangs bug dang mas sne gsang gnas su slebs pa/ g.yas su ro ma dmar po/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar po gnyis yas sne sna bug dang mas sne dbu mar 'dus pa'i mas sne 'dus mtshams su sems gtad la bsgom/ sgom tshul ni yan lag lnga bsam gtan gyi dus ltar bya/ sna bug gi rlung la sems gtad pa'i tshe rlung gi kha dog mthong tshe kha dog dang mthun pa'i las 'grub pa'i smon lam btab na gang btab 'grub par gsungs so// rang tha mal pa'i spu dkar nag mtshams su sems ma yeng bar gtad/ bde drod skyes tshe mdun du ri mo nag po la sems gtad nas bsgoms pas rtsa dbu ma mthong*/ de nas rim gyis rtsa 'khor rnams mthong*/

mthar gsang sngags kyi chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis shes par 'gyur te sa dang po'i bden pa mthong ba yin/ de nas 'od gsal dang 'dres nas bogs 'don pa ni/ gnyid la 'gro khar lus gnad sogs sngar ltar gyi mdun gyi stong gzugs la rlung dmigs sems gsum gtad/ gnyid la 'gro khar rlung dmigs sems gsum sna rtser phab la dar cig bsgoms pas brtan par 'gyur ba dang*/ lus gnad bkrol nas seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis gnyid log pas 'od gsal mthug srab gang rung zin par 'gyur ro// zin pa'i tshe sngar ltar bsam gtan gyi yan lag lngas nyams su blang ngo*// thun mtshams su bsre bas bogs dbyung ba ni/ bde sdug bar ma nad gdon la sogs ci byung yang 'od gsal stong pa nyid las ma g.yos bzhin du bsam gtan yan lag lngas gnad du bsnun la bsgom mo// de ltar 'bad pas stong gzugs thams cad 'od gsal stong nyid dang ro mnyam zhing*/ rtags ni stong gzugs rnams phra 'tsher bdar gzhig dka' ba 'od sna tshogs 'phro ba ste mtshan nyid lnga ldan du 'byung*/ rang sems sna tshogs kyi mtshan 'dzin thams cad dang bral ba'i gsal stong zung 'jug gis dus 'da' ba 'byung ngo*// yon tan ni lha'i mig sogs sngon gnas dran pa/ gzhan sems shes pa/ 'chi 'pho rtogs pa ste/ mngon shes lnga dang mthar thug gdan gsum tshang ba'i sangs rgyas mi bskyod rdo rje'i go 'phang 'grub pa'o// de nas bar du dge ba gsung rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la srog 'dzin gnyis las/ dang po srog rtsol ni/ de'ang rgyud sde gzhan gyi lugs la sna bug gi rlung g.yas srog /g.yon rtsol ba zhes bshad kyang*/ 'dir sna bug gnyis ka'i rlung ni srog yin la/ de gnad du bsnun pa la 'bad pas rtsol zhes dgongs so// dus ni stong gzugs rnams brtan par mthong nas sna bug gi rlung mnyam du rgyu gzugs ma 'gag gi bar du yin no// de yang mun khung du lus gnad smin mtshams nas gyen du sor bco brgyad kyi bar mtshams su gtad/

rkang pa g.yas bskums pa'i rting pas gsang rtsa gnyis mnan g.yon de'i mdun du bzhag /lag pa gnyis bsnol te brla steng du bzhag pa dang*/ khu tshur bcangs pa snying khar bsnol ba gnyis gang bde bya'o// nyams len drug las/ thog mar rdor bzlas kyis rtsa lam sbyang ba ni/ srog gi rlung rngub pa oṃ sku rdo rje/ gnas pa hūm̐ thugs rdo rje/ dbyung ba āḥgasung rdo rje la sems ma yeng bar gtad/ mthar rngub pa dang dbyung ba je thung gnas pa je ring la btang bas 'byongs pa'i tshad ni srog gi rgyu ba chad pa 'byung ngo*// gzhan du rdor bzlas gnas pa āḥdang*| dbyung ba hūm̐ du gsungs kyang de las go log pa ni 'di ka'i khyad chos so// rlung rdor bzlas kyi skabs sems rlung la gtad cing*/ de yang bsam gtan gyi skabs ltar yan lag lngas nyams su blang ngo*// de 'byongs nas 'jam rlung dgang stong gi sbyor bas srog dbu mar 'dzud pa ni/ rlung mnyam rgyu'i dus bya bas mnyam rgyu mi 'dug na yon po srong ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyis mnyam rgyur bcug nas/ rlung ro bus shing brngubs nas sbyor ba bzhi ldan la rgyun ring du rlung bzung zhing sems bsam gtan gyi yan lag lnga bya'o// des tshud nas/ rtsub rlung bum can gyi srog dbu mar 'ching ba ni/ dgu phrugs bus la sna gnyis nas rngub cing dgang pa lhan cig rgyab rlung drag pos bsdams nas bum pa kha sbyor gyis yun ring du bzung nas sems gong ltar bya'o// des srog dbu mar tshud cing 'ching ba'i rtags/ srog gi rgyu ba mi mngon par bum pa can je ring la song nas srog 'gags shing rnam rtog rgyun 'chad pa 'byung ngo*// de gnyis kas ma tshud ma 'ching na/ drag rlung btsan thabs kyis nyi zla'i lam dgag pa ni/ lus gnad gong ltar las/ lag pas rba rlabs bcings pa thog mar gcig nas mthar brgya stong gi bar du je mang du bcings pas dang por 'khrul snang 'char/

de'i tshe bsam gtan gyi yan lag lngas gnad du bsnun pas mthar spros bral bde stong 'od gsal sgyu ma lta bur 'char ba ni gnad zab pa'i mthar thug pa ste lag len zhal la dris shig /'di'i las phran btsan thabs kyis 'pho ba ni/ rang lhar gsal ba'i khong par rtsa dbu ma'i lte ba man chad ljang gu/ de man sngon po/ yar sne tshangs bug dang mar sne gsang gnas su zug pa'i lte ba'i thad du dmar cha a thung bshos bu zur gsum gyi dbyibs can nas tsam dang*/ spyi bor dkar cha haṃ yig mgo thur bstan/ snying khar sems kyi ngo bo hūm̐ nag po bsam/ thog mar rlung sbyangs steng rlung brngubs nas mnan pa'i tshe haṃ zhu nas snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim/ rgyab rlung drag tu 'then pas lte ba'i 'og gi a shad yar 'phos hūm̐ la thim/ rba rlabs bcings pas hūm̐ spar nas rlung sems tha mi dad tshangs bug tu thon par bsam/ sbyong ba'i tshe tshangs bug rdo rje rgya gram gyis bcad nas hūm̐ tshangs bug nas yar mi 'don par dmigs| ngal gso dus srog btang bas yi ge gsum po so sor bab par bsam/ 'byongs rtags spyi dang 'dra/ las sbyor 'chi ba'i dus la bab na rgya gram bsal/ hūm̐ nam mkhar 'phang rba rlabs drag la yun ring bar bcing*/ mthar dbyings rig bsres pas mchog 'grub par 'gyur ro// de ltar bkag pas 'og sgo 'gags nas srog rlung steng du btang bas grol ba ni dri chen 'gags na sna bug g.yon bkag /g.yas nas srog drag tu brngubs la lte bar gnon mi thub tshe g.yas bkag /g.yon drag po btang bas grol/ dri chu 'gags na de las go ldog la nyams su blangs pas grol/ 'di'i 'phros don srog rlung gi sbyor bas las mang du sgrub pa'i tshe kho bo'i khrid che bar gsal lo// 'di'i rjes su bskyed rim dang bsdu rim gyi dkyil 'khor bcu 'gog pa ni yan lag yin pas 'dir ma bris so// des ni las rlung thams cad ye shes kyi rlung 'ba' zhig tu rgyu zhing 'gags la/

rtags ni rang gi mdzod spu sha pags 'phrig cing za ba dang g.ya' ba 'byung*/ spyi bo mi bzod pa'i tsha tshig dang stong gzugs thams cad ches cher gsal zhing 'bar ba 'byung ngo*// rtags can byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis rang nyid mchod pa byed par 'gyur ro// des ni gdan gsum tshang ba'i sangs rgyas don yod grub pa'i go 'phang myur du 'grub par gdon mi za'o// gnyis pa srog rtsol sbyangs pas rlung sems dbu mar tshud pa de nyid rtsa 'khor rnams su 'dzin pa'i phyir/ 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor la/ sngon 'gro srog thur sel bsre ba ni/ rlung yon po bsrong ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyis bcos nas mnyam rgyu byung ba'i tshe/ hūm̐ zhes ring por srog phyir bus nas/ nang du ma brngub pa'i ngang nas hūm̐ zhes thung ngus thur sel drag tu 'then cing rgya mtsho ri rab la sbyar ba grangs mang du bya/ de ltar mang du byas pas thur sel dbang du 'dus rtags pho smad sbo 'khrog pa 'byung*/ de'i tshe srog steng nas drangs pa dang kha sbyar ba yun ring du sbyang ngo*// dngos gzhi bum pa can dus kyi gnas drug tu bcings pa 'dzin pa'i dngos gzhi ni/ rang lhar gsal ba'i khong par rtsa gsum kha dog sngar lta bu la dbu ma'i yar sne gtsug tor nas mdun du sgug pa'i smin mtshams dang mar sne gsang gnas su mdun du rdo rje'i bu gar zug pa khu ba bab pa/ ro rkyang gnyis yar sne sna bug gnyis su zug pa/ ro ma'i mar sne lte 'og nas mdun du 'khyog pa rdo rjer phyogs pa dri chu 'bab pa/ rkyang ma'i mar sne lte 'og nas rgyab tu phyogs pa dri chen 'bab pa/ rtsa gsum 'dus mtshams lte bar sa khams kyi 'khor lor rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pa/ snying khar chu khams kyi rtsa 'dab nang rim bzhi dang phyi rim brgyad/ mgrin par me khams nang rim brgyad dang phyi rol bcu drug de'i phyir so gnyis/ dpral bar rlung khams nag po nang rim bzhi dang phyi rim brgyad de'i phyir bcu drug

/gtsug tor nam mkha'i khams sngon po tshangs bug las sor gcig gi 'og tu 'dab ma bzhi/ gsang gnas su ye shes kyi khams ljang khu 'dab ma nang rim bcu dang phyi rim bcu drug rnams gsal btab/ lus gnad sngar rdor bzlas kyi skabs ltar byas nas hūm̐ ring gis bsregs/ phyir bus nas ma brngub pa'i gong du huṃ thung thur sel yar brngubs/ slar srog dal bus brngubs nas dgang zhing lce ya rkan la sbyar nas/ mig gyen du bsgrad cing bum can gsum nas brgya'i bar gang thub bzung ba'i ring rlung sems lte ba'i rtsa 'khor la ma yeng bar bzung ba'i mthar lte ba'i rtsa 'khor 'od du zhu nas snying ga'i rtsa 'khor la thim par bsam pa ni lte ba'i bum can no// yang hūm̐ṃ ring thung sogs gong ltar la bum can dang rlung sems snying gar bzung ba'i mthar snying ga'i rtsa 'dab 'od du zhu ba mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor la thim pa ni mgrin pa'i bum can no// yang hūm̐ ring thung bum can sogs sngar ltar rlung sems mgrin par bzung rjes mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor 'od du zhu ba dpral ba'i rtsa 'khor la bstim pa ni mgrin pa'i bum can no// yang hūm̐ ring thung bum can sogs sngar ltar gyis dpral bar rlung sems bzung rjes dpral ba'i rtsa 'khor 'od du zhu nas gtsug tor gyi rtsa 'khor la bstim pa ni dpral ba'i bum can no// yang hūm̐ ring thung bum can rlung sems sogs sngar ltar gtsug tor du bzung rjes gtsug tor gyi rtsa 'khor thams cad 'od du zhu ba gsang gnas kyi rtsa 'khor la bstim pa ni gtsug tor gyi bum can no// yang hūm̐ ring thung bum can rlung sems sogs sngar ltar gsang gnas su bzung rjes gsang gnas kyi rtsa 'khor 'od du zhu ba hūm̐ nag por gyur pa dbu ma'i nang nas yar phyung ba snying khar sleb tshe 'od lngar gyur pa rang lus rtsa gsum dang bcas pa 'od du mer mer 'bar ba la shes pa gtad nas bum can ci thub bzung ba'i mthar 'od lnga 'ja' yal ba ltar dmigs med du ci gnas su bzhag go// 'di'i skabs bde ba chen po g.yo ches pa na/

dmigs pa dang 'khrul 'khor gyi spog pa sogs ni kho bos bgyis pa'i sbyor drug gi khrid yig che bar gsal ba ltar bya'o// de nas bcud len gyi mchog lce gsum bskyod pa'i nang gi bdud rtsi 'thung ba ni/ lus gnad sor sdud kyi skabs ltar la/ tshangs bug gi thad klad rgya'i nang du zla dkyil mthe bong tsam pa'i lte bar byang sems kyi rang bzhin nu ma'i dbyibs can bdud rtsi 'dzag la khad pa'i mthar dbyangs bcu drug gis bskor bar bsam/ mchu bcud dgang nas hūm̐ ring gis srog bus/ huṃ thung gis thur sel drangs/ slar srog kha sna gsum ga nas brngubs nas bkang bas rang byung gi gtum mo'i drod rlung gis bskul bas dkar cha nu ma lta bu dbyangs yig dang bcas pa las bdud rtsi skya nur gyi bab pa ya rkan gyi lce'u chung brgyud nas bab pa gzhib pas lus thams cad bdud rtsis gang nas/ bsam gtan zag med kyi bde bas myos shing tshims par bsams nas lces lce'u chung bskul zhing gzhib pas dang por mchil ma bab mthar ro mngar ba dang bcas bab pa myangs bas bcud len thams cad kyi mchog yin pa rgyud nas gsungs so// de ltar bzung bas bum can drug bsgoms pa'i rtags tshad ni/ sngar gyi stong gzugs rnams nyams myong dang 'dres zhing cher gsal ba dang*/ gzhom du med pa'i gzugs| sgra/ dri/ ro/ reg bya/ chos la longs spyod pa dang*/ srog thur 'dres pas ye shes kyi gtum mo'i yon tan mngon du gyur/ bza' btung ri rab tsam zos kyang 'ju la/ til 'bru tsam ma zos kyang bkres skom gyi snang ba mi 'byung*/ mthar gdan gsum tshang ba'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan gyi go 'phang mngon du byed pa/ bum can drug gi skabs rtsa 'khor drug gi dmigs pa dang rlung dang stong gzugs kyi snang ba gsum dbyer med bsal bzhag med pa der 'dzin bral zhing lhan skyes su nyams su blang ba la rnam gsum ro gcig pa zhes tha snyad mdzad do// gsum pa tha mar dge ba thugs rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la rjes dran dang ting 'dzin gnyis las/

dang po rjes su dran pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ sngon du sbyangs pa'i stong gzugs dang nyams myong ji snyed pa phyag rgya gsum gyi gdams pas bogs 'don zhing yon tan 'phel bar byed pa yin pas/ de yang rnal 'byor pa'i khams sla ba dang*/ ska ba dang*/ shin tu ska ba'i dbye bas phyag rgya gsum du gsungs pa las/ thog mar khams sla ba'i gang zag gis dman pa las kyi phyag rgya bsten pa ni/ srog rtsol rtsa rlung gis sbyang ba'i phyir bzhugs stang gsum dang*/ thig le sbyang ba'i phyir 'phrul 'khor drug /dngos gzhi rang lus dang gzhan lus thabs ldan gnyis sogs ni 'dir ma bshad pas rtogs par 'dod na kho bos bgyis pa'i sbyor drug gi khrid yig rnam 'byed shing rtar bshad pa 'dra byos shig /khams ska ba'i gang zag gis gtum mo rtag pa'i dam tshig phyag rgya nyams su blangs te/ rang lhar gsal ba'i khong par rtsa gsum gyi 'khyog tshul 'dzin pa'i skabs ltar gsal ba'i lte bar rtsa 'dab bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte bar gtum mo'i me hoḥyig mtshan nyid bzhi dang ldan pa/ dbu ma'i yar sne mdzod spur phyogs mtshams su thig le dkar po mthe bong tsam zhig dngul chu ltar 'dril bar bsam/ hūm̐ ring thung gis srog thur bum can du bkang bas lte ba'i hoḥlas ye shes kyi me 'bar bas dbu ma'i nang brgyud thig le la reg pas byang sems phab pas dpral bar dga' ba/ mgrin par mchog dga'/ snying khar dga' bral/ lte bar lhan skyes la mnyam par bzhag /slar srog rtsol gyis sbar bas byang sems me dang 'dres pas gyen du log pa lte bar dga' ba/ snying khar mchog dga'/ mgrin par dga' bral/ dpral bar lhan skyes/ mthar dmar cha me dang*/ dkar cha'i rgyun 'dres pas gtsug tor nas rkang mthil yan ba spu'i khung tshun dkar dmar 'dres pas khrigs se gang*/ bde drod kyi ye shes cher 'bar bas rnam rtog tshogs drug gi snang ba thams cad shi nas bde chen mi rtog pa'i ngang du brgyal ba la yun ring du bsgom pa'o// khams shin tu ska ba'i gang zag gis dam tshig gi phyag rgya nyams su blang ba ni/

rang dus 'khor yab yum dang kha sbyor ba'i lhan skyes sgrub thabs ltar gsal ba'i yab kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ nag po/ lte bar hoḥser po/ gtsug tor du swā ljang gu/ gsang bar hā sngon po bsam/ mkha' gsang byin rlabs sgrub thabs ltar byas nas/ yab kyi khong par rtsa gsum dpral mgrin snying lte gsang ba'i 'khor lo lnga gsal btab/ snyoms 'jug byas pas dpral ba'i 'khor lo nas byang sems bab pas dga' ba/ snying khar mchog dga'/ lte bar dga' bral/ gsang bar lhan skyes su mnyam par bzhag /ches srub pa'i tshe nor bu'i rtse mor son pa 'phor nye ba na/ hūm̐ ring thung sogs srog rtsol gyi rlung bum can 'dzin pa'i skabs lta bus bzung zhing ldog pas lte bar dga' ba/ snying khar mchog dga'/ mgrin par dga' bral/ dpral bar lhan skyes su mnyam par bzhag |mthar bde stong lhan skyes kyi rang zhal bzo bral brjod med kyi bde ba dang rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa gnyis zung 'jug tu 'jog pa ni phyag rgya chen po ste/ 'di ni gong gi phyag rgya gsum ga'i nyams len la sbyar ba shin tu gal che'o// de ltar phyag rgya gsum po la 'bad pa'i rtags tshad ni/ sa bcu rnam par dag pas rtags bcu'i stong gzugs shin tu brtan pa dang*/ gnas skabs bcu'i dri ma dag /rtags snang ni/ rang gi lus lhar gsal ba las 'od 'phros pas nam mkha'i khams gang zhing rang lus 'od kyi nang du tshud pa thim pa sogs 'byung*/ mthar gdan gsum tshang ba'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi go 'phang nges par 'grub pa'o// gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bsam gtan ni/ lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun dang ldan pas/ rlung gnad ni/ ma ning gi rlung zhes bya ba srog thur gnyis ka rtsol ba spangs la rang sor bzhag la/ sems kyi bsam gtan ni/ dus zhabs snyan brgyud las/ /sgom pa dmigs bcas stong gzugs dang*// dmigs med bde ba ro mnyam las// sems ni mi g.yo brtan par gnas// dngos po thams cad bde 'char ro// zhes gsungs/

sngar gyi sor sdud dang bsam gtan gyi skabs su mthong ba'i stong gzugs rnams snang stong*/ srog rtsol dang 'dzin pa'i dus shar ba'i shes pa gsal stong*/ rjes dran gyi dus nyams su myong ba'i myong ba ni bde stong*| de thams cad ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag go// de yang 'dres pa zhes/ rgyu mi gcig pa chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa lta bu ma yin pa/ rgyu gcig pa chu gnyis bsres pa lta bu yang ma yin pa/ bde ba dang bral ba'i stong pa phyal chad/ stong pa bral ba'i bde ba skyed 'dod/ gsal ba dang bral ba'i stong pa med dgag /stong pa dang bral ba'i gsal snang rtag lta sogs phyag rdzogs dbu gsum gyi lam gyis ma bslad pa'i rnam kun mchog ldan gzhom med don dam pa'i dus kyi 'khor lo'i gsal bzhag spangs pa'i ngang du gdod nas grub pa la der 'dzin gyi 'dzin stangs med par mnyam par 'jog pa ni/ don gyi snying po rdzogs rim gyi rtsa ba nyams len gyi nying khu kho na yin no// de ltar bsgoms pas rtags tshad ni lus sems snang cha tshogs drug thams cad bde stong gnyis med du 'char ba sogs rtags snang thams cad lkog gyur du ma lus pa'i rnal 'byor pas mngon sum tshad grub tu nyams su myong ba sogs thun mong gi yon tan mtha' dag 'thob bo// mthar thug rtsa rlung thig le thams cad ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bor dag pas gdan gsum tshang ba'i sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i ngo bor 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro// de ltar yan lag drug po bsgoms pas rnal 'byor pa rab sngon bsags dang ldan pas na zla ba gsum tshun la mchog 'grub cing*/ tha ma skal pa dman pas bar do tshun la mchog 'grub la/ skal pa 'bring dag gis ni/ lo gsum dang zla ba gsum la 'bad pas bsgom pas zhag re la rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgyar 'gyur bas lo gsum phyogs gsum la nyin zhag phrugs stong phrag gcig dang nyis brgya bdun cu tham pa 'byung bas de'i ring la/

nyin mtshan dbye ba med par rtse gcig nyams su blang ba'i tshe/ zhag grangs de rnams kyi ring bde stong lhan skyes byang chub kyi sems rlung dang tha mi dad pa zag bcas 'jig rten pa'i bde ba las 'das pa de dag gis gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo'i phyed gang bas sa dang po 'thob/ ril por gang bas sa gnyis pa/ lte ba'i phyed gang bas sa gsum pa/ ril por gang bas sa bzhi pa/ snying ga'i phyed gang bas sa lnga pa/ ril por gang bas sa drug pa/ mgrin pa'i phyed gang bas sa bdun pa/ ril por gang bas sa brgyad pa/ dpral ba'i phyed gang bas sa dgu pa/ ril por gang bas sa bcu pa/ gtsug tor gyi phyed gang bas sa bcu gcig pa/ ril por gang bas sa bcu gnyis pa/ lus thams cad gang bas sa bcu gsum pa 'thob/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga/ yan lag gi rlung stong dang brgyad brgya/ khams so gnyis/ rtsa nyi khri dgu 'bum/ sku bcu drug la sogs pa dag nas/ rnam kun mchog ldan rnam med rnam pa can gyi rang gzugs sku drug yongs su rdzogs pa khyab bdag dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i go 'phang thob par byed pa ni mi bslu ba yang dag pa'i tshad ma yin no// zhes bya ba rdzogs rim thams cad kyi mthar thug sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i skabs so// de ltar bla med lhan skyes rnam bzhi'i rdzogs rim shin tu bsdus pa ste/ deng sang gi dus snyigs ma lnga bdo zhing mi rnams tshe thung ba dang shes rab dman pas yig cha dang dmigs pa ches mang na blo gros kyi khyon chung ngur mi shong bas nyes pa 'gog pa dang*/ rang nyid kyang rnam g.yeng gi dbang dang blo gros dman zhing sngon bsags kyi skal pa'i phul ches cher zhan pas brjed ngas kyi dran pa gso ba'i phyir/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi snying po rnams legs par thos shing 'doms par byas nas| slar rdzogs rim 'di rnams lung rig 'phros don gyi spros pa bskyungs shing*/ dmigs pa gtso che ba med mi rung ba rnams bsdus/

de dag kyang sa spyad tho tsam ma gtogs tshig tshogs shin tu nyung bar bgyis pa 'di'ang*/ dus mtha'i rdo rje 'dzin pa 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas/ me mo glang gi lo nag pa can gyi phyogs snga ma'i rdzogs pa gsum pa rgyal bas dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten chen por/ shākya zla ba bzang po la mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyud chen gsungs pa'i dus dge bar sbyar ba yin gyi/ 'di la brtson pa lhur byed pa dag gis ni 'di tsam la nan tan bgyis pas rdo rje 'chang chen po 'grub par gdon mi za la/ yang lung rig dang tshig don rgyas pa la mos pa dag gis ni 'di rnams rtsa bar byas te/ mtha' gcod rang rang gi khrid yig chen po rnams dang*/ rgyud gzhung 'grel pa dang bcas pa rnams su rtogs par gyis shig
